facts.rationale: Corrects conflation of launch-generation mode with per-item runtime mode and preserves allocation-failure and zero-request branches omitted by the existing explanation.
facts.value: Loops while request xC is nonzero, calling the capacity helper before each allocation attempt. A failed allocation leaves the budget unchanged and has no local failure exit. Request x10 == 1 enables a once-only budget adjustment after the first successful allocation and generated velocity during each instance's initialization. Runtime state selection is independent: request x14 is copied to item-variable x8, and item x8 == 1 selects state 0 with accessory tracking; other values select state 1. Thus the direct-velocity wrapper, which sets request x10 = 0 and x14 = 1, initializes state 0. The returned local is assigned only by the first successful mode-1 adjustment; an initially zero budget or a completed direct-mode request has no initialized return value in this source. The direct wrapper ignores that result.

evidence.why: Complete helper and activation routine establish exact read, write and call order.

facts.rationale: Corrects the existing claim that descriptor evaluation precedes setting xC. Canonical code sets the initialization flag before invoking the descriptor helper.
facts.value: Reads item-variable x8, animation-initialized flag xC and tier index x4. When x8 == 1 and xC is nonzero, it selects state 0 with ITEM_HIT_PRESERVE | ITEM_UNK_0x1 and skips tier-descriptor reapplication. When x8 == 1 and xC is zero, it selects state 0 with ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE, writes xC = 1, then applies and evaluates the selected tier's state descriptor. Both state-0 paths subsequently assign it_802E6A74 to on_accessory. For other x8 values it selects state 1 with ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE and applies/evaluates the tier descriptor, without a local xC write or accessory assignment.
